name: Harrandarr
description: Harrandarr was a planet located in the Harrandarr system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Bosph sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Buzchub species. Und'l, a Buzchub who worked for Galactic Empire sympathizers on the Expansion Region astronomical object Roldalna shortly after the establishment of the New Republic in 4 ABY, hailed from Harrandarr.
